one_liner: Senior DoD IT program manager at DMDC who runs multi-year IT programs and writes IT policy, strategic plans and investment/performance management guidance.
fit_summary: This GS-13 2210 role requires a year of GS-12-level IT program management, including IT investment and portfolio management and specific DoD systems. Daniel's IT work is first-line troubleshooting at IEM, so he won't meet the minimum qualifications, and education can't substitute.
eligibility: Open to the public and military spouses under DoD Direct Hire Authority, so no federal status or veterans' preference is needed, and there is no rating-and-ranking.

You need one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-12 covering IT laws and policy, IT life-cycle, investment and performance management, program controls, and DoD systems (Integrated Business Framework, DITPR, Data Center Inventory Management).
You must meet the 2210 Individual Occupational Requirement: IT-related experience showing Attention to Detail, Customer Service, Oral Communication and Problem Solving.
The position requires a Secret security clearance, and education cannot substitute for experience at GS-13.
Location is listed as multiple locations, with telework allowed but not remote work.
strategy: Skip this one: it requires a year of GS-12-level IT program management, including IT investment and portfolio management, and his IT work is first-line troubleshooting at IEM.
GS-0301 or GS-0343 program and emergency management roles fit his resume.
resume_bullets: Handled first-line IT troubleshooting with IT support at IEM (2019–2024).
Brought emergency management best practices into a large travel company's emergency forms (Feb – Aug 2024).
interview_questions: Describe a multi-year IT program you led from requirements through execution. How did you control scope, schedule and cost?
How have you used performance or investment data to recommend changes to an IT portfolio?
Tell us about a time you developed or interpreted policy that governed IT activities, and how you communicated it to staff.
What experience do you have with DoD systems such as DITPR or the Integrated Business Framework?
watch_outs: The specialized experience is highly IT- and DoD-specific; without it, your application will likely be screened out at minimum qualifications.
You must be able to obtain and keep a Secret clearance.
There is no promotion potential, and remote work is not allowed, so he would need to work on site at least part of the time.
